_comment: This file decides which provider and which markets the card may use.
It ships allowlisting NOTHING, and that is the correct state until a
market has been measured against real prices and Cooper has reviewed
the evidence and signed a human acceptance receipt.
Claude may prepare a change to this file and open a pull request for
it. Claude may never add a name to allowed_provider_names, add a market
to required_markets, or write a receipt. See

known_limitations: No market is supported by the evidence, and none survives correction and then replicates. `points` (-4.5%) and `blocked_shots` (+5.2%) survive correction on the pooled `late` window and within neither season; `hits` is measured only in the `card` window (-1.2% over 5,021, interval including zero); `regulation_3_way` and `team_total` have never been measured against real prices.

Approved against the bundle's own recommendation on 2026-09-23 and re-attested twice on 2026-09-24. The prior approval of the same markets was withdrawn on 2026-08-29. Two corrections have moved the evidence since: the team measurement took the best price across two windows and after face-off, and corrected, all three team markets measure lower with every interval still including zero; and the replication record still counted every book's quote as a bet, and rebuilt, `points` no longer replicates as a loss. Neither adds support for any market.

_withdrawn: The 2026-08-27 approval of all eleven markets was WITHDRAWN on
2026-08-29, because the evidence it cited moved underneath it.
The receipt was signed against a backtest reporting +1.4% over 4,830
bets with an interval including zero. Buying the full two-season
population replaced that sample with 73,918 bets and the answer
changed sign: -1.6%, interval -2.3% to -0.8%, excluding zero on the
losing side and surviving correction for the seven markets tested.
The one positive market, blocked_shots, failed replication.
Claude withdrew it. Claude did not, and cannot, decide to re-enable
anything: that needs Cooper to read the new evidence and sign a new
receipt. Withdrawal is the only direction Claude may move this file,
because it can only ever reduce what the card is allowed to do.
The superseded receipt is kept under human_acceptance_receipts/
superseded/ as a record. It approves nothing from there.
